$comment: Failures develop-stack expects on develop today, each with the ticket or ruling that explains it.
The develop-stack Verdict fails only on a failure NOT listed here, so a red run means something new broke.
Keys: <config>|<project>|<spec file>|<describe > ... > test title> (no line numbers, so editing a spec does not unlist a test).
Values: ticket (an OGC key, 'harness' for a test fault, 'ci-env' for a CI-only seeding or environment gap, or 'untriaged'), note, since.
When a listed test passes, the run reports it under 'Known reds now passing': take it out of this file and check its ticket.
To accept a batch after triage: node scripts/ci-known-reds.mjs seed --from <downloaded shard artifacts>, then set the tickets.
bootstrap: true means new failures are reported but do not fail the run. It is on only until the first seeded run; turn it off in the same PR that seeds the list.
